preconditions.description: The length of the tiles string must be between 1 and 7 inclusive.
All characters in the tiles string must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(tiles) + 1) for perm in permutations(tiles, i) if perm not in seen)
postconditions.description: The return value must be the count of unique non-empty sequences that can be formed from the tiles.
